image.description: CD/DVD image file or device path (required)

store_path.description: Directory where rescued files will be stored (required)

h2i_file.description: Optional H2i file path for heavily damaged media (H2cdimage format)

auto_accept.description: Store all found files without prompting user interaction

use_mime.description: Use MIME types instead of file descriptions for identification

log_file.description: Path to the log file; defaults to 'dares.log'
